name: 134.3 — a gob label wears a font
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 134.3: the label an overlay stands at a gob is blitted in a face of the addon's own -- so the record reads back the handle it was given and refuses what is not one, and the label and a g:text of the same string in the same face are one cache entry, outline and all.
